title: Arrangement
description: The HW002 arrangement file (arrangements/<id>.json under the arranger's data folder): the recipe each page adds its structure to. Written by hand to match contrib/arranger/arrangement.py, whose tests check that the two agree. Keys a later step adds are kept by every writer, so the object is open.

saved.description: Unix time of the arranger page's last save.

transitions.description: The transitions page: each pick with the section change it lands at.

mix.description: Mix 1: each channel's gain, pan and cuts.

mix2.description: Mix 2: the devices kept, in order.

spectral.description: The spectral fixes kept, each with its parts (a gain move or a device with values).

kickFuzz.description: The kick option kept (kickfuzz.py), or null for HW002's kick as it is.

desk.description: The mix desk's recipe (contrib/mixdesk/recipe.py); its shape is desk.schema.json.

off.description: Bars into the loop where the region enters it.
